name: WordPress
support: Open-source software maintained by a global community and supported by many hosting companies.
technology: PHP, MySQL or MariaDB, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
capabilities: Supports blogs, business sites, and online stores
limitations: Too many plugins can slow performance

name: Drupal
support: Open-source software maintained by the Drupal community and supported by professional agencies.
technology: PHP, Symfony, MySQL, MariaDB, or PostgreSQL.
capabilities: Suitable for large and complex websites

name: Joomla
support: Open-source software supported by volunteers and the Joomla community.

name: Ghost
support: Open-source publishing platform developed by the Ghost Foundation.
technology: Node.js, JavaScript, MySQL, HTML, and CSS.
limitations: Managed hosting may require a paid plan

name: Shopify
support: Commercial hosted platform developed and maintained by Shopify Inc.
technology: Ruby on Rails, Liquid templates, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Shopify-managed databases.
